name: SPX-H3000
description: Reference-grade analyzer for high-volume core labs with flagship precision. Delivers a complete CBC with 5-part differential and NRBC enumeration in a single walkaway workflow.

name: SPX-H2600
description: Balanced workload hematology for mid-to-large laboratories. Combines a generous sample loader with slide-free digital review for uninterrupted shift throughput.

name: SPX-H2000
description: Compact footprint with 5-part performance for satellite laboratories. Capillary and venous sampling support make it ideal for space-constrained clinical environments.

name: SPX-H1800
description: Reliable everyday hematology with rugged, low-maintenance optics. Small sample volumes and dual measuring channels keep turnaround fast and reagent costs down.

name: SPX-H1200
description: Cost-efficient 5-part counting for growing clinical workloads. Frequency-based detection removes daily flushing requirements and simplifies maintenance.

name: SPX-H800
description: Self-contained 3-part analyzer for clinics and small hospitals. Hydrodynamic focusing and a touchscreen workflow deliver dependable CBC results with minimal footprint.

name: SPX-H500
description: Desktop 3-part hematology for point-of-collection testing. Whole blood and diluted modes add flexibility for outpatient and outreach laboratories.

name: SPX-H300
description: Entry-level CBC analyzer for clinics and field laboratories. Minimal reagent consumption and an internal printer make it a practical choice for low-volume testing.

name: SPX-B4000
description: Total-lab chemistry solution with concurrent ISE and reflex testing. Large onboard reagent capacity and automated rerun rules keep high-volume workflows moving.

name: SPX-B3000
description: Cross-contamination-free chemistry for mid-to-large laboratories. Intelligent cuvette washing and active reagent cooling protect assay integrity hour after hour.

name: SPX-B2000
description: Open-system flexibility with barcode-guided sample handling. A rotating sample ring and rich assay menu make it suited to mixed or growing workloads.

name: SPX-B1600
description: Space-saving analyzer that pairs high output with low reagent waste. An optional integrated ISE module broadens the test menu without adding bench space.

name: SPX-B900
description: Simple, reliable chemistry for clinics and small hospital labs. One-touch start and auto-cleaning probe design keep operation straightforward for every operator.

name: SPX-I6000
description: Flagship immunoassay platform with onboard dilution and reflex rules. Broad cardiovascular and endocrine menus in a single magnetic-separation CLIA walkaway system.

name: SPX-I4000
description: Random-access immunoassay with a broad cardiovascular menu. Onboard refrigerated storage and automated re-run modes keep routine panels efficient.
